game.title: Las Vegas Raiders at New England Patriots

lede: New England Patriots carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New England Patriots -8.7 with a fair total of 42.2, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Las Vegas Raiders run offence vs New England Patriots run defence, which sits −0.198 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
